subject: Math
prompt: A community pantry is distributing free meal kits each day. The equation $g(t) = 224 - 16t$ gives the number of free meal kits, $g(t)$, that remain to be distributed after $t$ days. Which of the following is the best interpretation of $g(14) = 0$ in this context?

choices.A: The pantry has $14$ free meal kits to distribute.
choices.B: The pantry will distribute $14$ free meal kits in $16$ days.
choices.C: It will take $14$ days to distribute all the free meal kits.
choices.D: It will take $224$ days to distribute $14$ free meal kits.

explanation: Choice C is correct. It's given that $g(t) = 224 - 16t$ gives the number of free meal kits that remain to be distributed after $t$ days. The equation $g(14) = 0$ corresponds to $t = 14$ and $g(t) = 0$. Since $t$ represents the number of days and $g(t)$ represents the number of meal kits remaining, $g(14) = 0$ means that after $14$ days, there are $0$ meal kits remaining. Therefore, the best interpretation of $g(14) = 0$ in this context is that it will take $14$ days to distribute all the free meal kits.
